events.title: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
events.description: Authorities have evacuated a 5-mile radius to prepare to dispose of thousands of pounds of lead azide. And, after a nearly two-year legal battle, Kilmar Abrego Garcia's has voluntarily left the U.S.

events.title: China investigates Politburo member and Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
events.description: The Politburo member is the latest senior official targeted in President Xi Jinping's long-running anti-corruption campaign, which has shown no signs of letting up in scope or depth.

events.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia. And, Rep. Gomez resigns amid alleged sexual misconduct
events.description: President Trump took credit for negotiating Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia. And, Rep. Jimmy Gomez, D-Calif., says his resignation will be effective Dec. 1.

events.title: The human cost of the electric vehicle boom is at the center of a lawsuit in Congo
events.description: A landmark lawsuit in Congo sees 27 residents accuse a Chinese-owned copper and cobalt mine of poisoning their community and the government of failing to protect them.

events.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
events.description: High in the Colombian Andes, a growing number of volunteers are racing to save an unusual plant that helps supply water to millions — one tiny seedling at a time.

events.title: €561 Billion and Still Not Enough: Germany's 2027 Budget Exposes a Coalition on the Brink
events.description: The budget for 2027 has reached new highs, and pension funds, defense spending and a weak economy are increasing the pressure. At the same time, tensions are mounting within the government.

events.title: US Army detonates unstable lead-based explosives in Iowa
events.description: The US Army says a controlled blast is the safest way to deal with explosive chemicals that began crystallizing in storage. US President Donald Trump said "mitigation efforts have far exceeded expectations."

events.title: EU must set out a new timeline for cage-free farming, court rules
events.description: European General Court ruled that the European Commission has failed to set out a timeline after pledging to end caged farming by the end of 2023.

events.title: Nigeria's upcoming election marred by rising AI disinformation
events.description: As Nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?

events.title: US plans new tariffs on EU, China and 12 others
events.description: The Trump administration is planning new import duties of up to 20% to counter excessive manufacturing abroad. The measures could put further pressure on US consumers already struggling with high living costs.

events.title: In Afghanistan, no female doctor often means no treatment for women
events.description: Millions of women in Afghanistan, particularly pregnant women, are suffering under Taliban restrictions and are increasingly losing access to life-saving medical care.

events.title: Spain: Catalan separatist Puigdemont sets date for return
events.description: Former Catalan leader Carles Puigdemont plans to return to Barcelona on December 12 after nearly a decade in exile. Spain's Supreme Court has dropped the criminal case against him, clearing the way for his return.

events.title: North Korea expels Swiss envoy over sanctions on camp accused of indoctrinating Ukrainian children
events.description: North Korea has ordered Switzerland to close its newly reopened diplomatic office. The dispute centers on Swiss sanctions against a camp accused of indoctrinating Ukrainian children from Russian-occupied territories.
events.ticker_label: 💥 North Korea expels Swiss envoy over sanctions on camp accused of indoctrinating Ukrainian children

events.title: Australia, Solomon Islands sign sweeping pact seen as countering China
events.description: Australia will become the Solomon Islands' primary security partner, while the archipelago will reject any foreign power trying to "interfere" on its "sensitive" infrastructure.

events.title: German auto workers on back foot as costs, competition bite
events.description: German auto workers profited during the industry's boom years, but are now increasingly being asked to trade past gains for future job security.

events.title: Top Spanish court closes case against Catalan separatist leader
events.description: Spain's Supreme Court has applied a controversial amnesty law to former Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont, closing criminal proceedings against him over his role in the region's failed 2017 independence bid. The ruling, which comes ahead of a snap general election on Sunday, marks the final step in the implementation of the amnesty law, passed by parliament in 2024.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Top Spanish court closes case against Catalan separatist leader

events.title: Huang's return fails to dispel doubts as Nvidia shares drop
events.description: A rally sparked by Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia's chief executive faded on Tuesday, with the company's shares falling as doubts persisted over the probes he faces and the fate of the AI investment boom. After vaulting more than 30 percent on Monday following Huang's shock comeback, Nvidia fell almost six percent Tuesday. Huang resigned on November 12 over extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy.

events.title: 'Paper Tiger': Scarlett Johansson and Adam Driver shine in Russian mob thriller
events.description: This week on arts24, Emma Jones and Dheepthika Laurent discuss the latest film releases. We start with "Paper Tiger", a Russian mob thriller starring Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller. It is a return to familiar crime thriller territory for James Gray, the director behind "Little Odessa" and "The Yards".

events.title: 'Historic' space mission: China launches Shenzhou 24 spacecraft carrying Pakistani astronaut
events.description: China on Wednesday launched the Shenzhou 24 spacecraft with three astronauts — two Chinese and a Pakistani — sending the first foreign crew member to its space station. It successfully separated from a rocket and entered its predetermined orbit. The launch marked the first joint flight involving Chinese and foreign astronauts in the history of China’s crewed space program.

events.title: Thomas Markle formally charged over child sexual abuse material
events.description: Thomas Markle has been formally charged on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material in Los Angeles.

events.title: Huawei guilty of plotting to steal trade secrets and bank fraud
events.description: Chinese tech giant Huawei, has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud after a landmark trial in the US.

events.title: Gisele Pelicot 'deeply shocked' as nude photos of her sent to media
events.description: Gisele Pelicot has said she is "deeply shocked" and "humiliated" after nude images of her were sent to the media without her consent to promote a new book about coercive control.

events.title: Cambodia hosts Chinese military for largest Golden Dragon joint exercise yet
events.description: Cambodia and China have started joint military exercises aimed at strengthening cooperation between Beijing and its closest political partner in Southeast Asia

events.title: Malaysia Airlines’ parent to buy 10 Boeing Dreamliners, with options for 6 more
events.description: Malaysia Airlines' parent company has announced plans to buy 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliners, with options for six more, as part of its fleet modernization strategy

events.title: Spain's economy has grown under Sánchez, but many voters aren't feeling it. 5 charts explain why
events.description: Spain's economy is growing faster than most of Europe, but many Spaniards are struggling with high living costs

events.title: Gisèle Pelicot condemns publisher for using nude images from her rape case in book promo
events.description: Gisèle Pelicot says she is shocked that a Paris publisher used nude images taken by her rapist ex-husband to promote a book about her case

events.title: Colombia: Guterres urges renewed commitment to landmark peace deal
events.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has commended Colombia for progress achieved in the decade since a landmark accord known as the Final Peace Agreement ended more than 50 years of insurgency but stressed the need to fully implement its provisions.

events.title: Guterres laments COP31 outcome, urges climate justice from Barbados
events.description: Secretary-General António Guterres on Sunday expressed deep disappointment over the collapse of COP31 climate negotiations, using a visit to Barbados to call for stronger action on fossil fuels, climate finance and support for vulnerable nations.

events.title: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild
events.description: For five years, Zahra cared for an elderly woman in Iran and earned enough to get by. Now back in Herat, western Afghanistan, the 28-year-old trained midwife is unemployed. She lives with her parents and siblings, apart from her six-year-old son, who lives with her ex-husband.

events.title: Slain student’s family faces first Thanksgiving without her, blames missed chances to stop illegal alien
events.description: Sheridan Gorman's parents share their first Thanksgiving without their daughter, saying Chicago authorities missed chances to arrest the suspect.

events.title: Kroger cuts thousands of jobs across America, recruits foreign workers and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Florida AG calls for doctor to lose medical license over 149 alleged illegal abortions
events.description: Florida's attorney general is pushing to revoke a North Miami Beach doctor's medical license, citing suspected violations of the Heartbeat Protection Act.

events.title: All 6 passengers found dead inside wreckage of plane off Mississippi coast
events.description: All six passengers aboard the Cessna 210 Centurion that went down roughly 2 miles northeast of Horn Island, Mississippi, have been found dead, according to the U.S. Coast Guard.
events.ticker_label: ✈️ All 6 passengers found dead inside wreckage of plane off Mississippi coast

events.title: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after historic service outage
events.description: Microsoft declared a "Code Red" after a historic 24-hour outage hit most of its 420 to 450 million users that wa blamed on a Windows scalability defect.

events.title: Christian filmmaker's discovery of Jewish roots sparks mission to uncover centuries-old secret
events.description: Evangelical Christian Laurie Cardoza-Moore says her film traces Anussim, descendants of Jews forced to convert during the Inquisition around 500 years ago.

events.title: Former Florida mayor urges American Jews to fight back against rising antisemitism
events.description: In "The Jewish Fight for America," Gabe Groisman says forces on the left and right are trying to distance American Jews from Israel and unlearn Zionism.

events.title: Iran flogs female singer 74 times for performing without hijab in viral YouTube concert
events.description: Lawyers said singer Parastoo Ahmadi and members of her concert team received 74 lashes each in Qom after performing without a hijab. They also face two-year bans.

events.title: Captain who abandoned passengers on sinking Costa Concordia cruise ship released early from prison
events.description: Costa Concordia captain Francesco Schettino is out of a Rome prison after 9 years, set to serve the remaining 7 years on supervised probation, lawyer says.
